notes: Playable Skaven army for WHR Army Builder.
Army-wide mainstay and composition rules are enforced or surfaced by skaven_extensions.js.

mounts.name: Screaming Bell
rules: Large chariot pushed by a Skaven regiment
1D6 Strength 6 impact hits
Natural dispel 4+ for Grey Seer and pushing unit

factionMagicItems.name: Fellblade
factionMagicItems.rules: Wounds automatically; no armour save; each wound becomes 1D6 wounds. At the start of each Skaven turn, on a 1 the bearer suffers a wound with no save.

factionMagicItems.name: Warpstorm Scroll
factionMagicItems.rules: Bound spell, one use. All creatures flying high, friend and foe, suffer 1D6 wounds; randomise wounds on ridden monsters.

factionMagicItems.name: Warpstone Charm
factionMagicItems.rules: Once per battle, re-roll one personal die roll and add or subtract 1 from the result.

factionMagicItems.name: Warpdust Amulet
factionMagicItems.rules: Enemies suffer -1 to hit and -1 to wound against the bearer.

factionMagicItems.name: Skavenbrew
factionMagicItems.rules: Feed to the bearer’s unit at the start of battle: 1 no effect; 2-3 hatred; 4-5 frenzy; 6 extreme frenzy (double M and A, with 1D3 regimental casualties each Skaven turn).

factionMagicItems.name: Sacred Standard of the Horned Rat
factionMagicItems.rules: Leadership 8 before rank bonus. Natural dispel 4+; power used for a successfully dispelled spell passes to the Skaven player.

factionMagicItems.name: Storm Banner
factionMagicItems.rules: One use. For one complete turn BS shooting suffers -2, other shooting works only on 4+, and flying is impossible.

faction.name: Skaven
armyWideRules: Strength in Numbers: eligible Skaven regiments add their rank bonus to Leadership tests.
Lead from the Back: Skaven characters may lead from the rear rank and may refuse challenges without losing their Leadership/rules/spellcasting benefits.
Warpstone weapons listed in the army book count as magical.
Clanrat Warriors are mainstay: the number of Clanrat Warrior regiments limits how many copies of every other regiment and war-machine choice may be included.
Run to Fight Another Day: all Skaven units flee an extra inch.
Lesser Breed: Rat Swarms, Giant Rats and Skaven Slaves do not cause panic in other Skaven units.
Skaven wizards carry one Warpstone Token per wizard level (except Vermin Lords); Grey Seers are safer when consuming them.

mainstay.description: Each non-mainstay regiment/war-machine choice is limited to the number of Clanrat Warrior regiments.

rules: Frenzy
May only join Plague Monks

characters.name: Assassin
rules: First Assassin counts towards Regiments; subsequent Assassins count towards Characters
Hides in a rank-and-file infantry regiment; maximum one Assassin per regiment
First combat round strikes before models with strike first and before challenges
Poisoned weapons add +1 Strength; each wound becomes 1D3 wounds
Cannot be the general and other models cannot use the Assassin's Leadership

regiments.name: Plague Monks
rules: Frenzy

regiments.name: Gutter Runners
rules: Scout
Must skirmish
Poisoned weapons count as magical

regiments.name: Night Runners
rules: Must skirmish
Vanguard: may make a march move after Scouts deploy but before turn 1

regiments.name: Poison Wind Globadiers
rules: Must skirmish
6-inch Poison Wind Globes: hit causes one automatic wound with no armour save
Natural 1 to hit: firer suffers a wound on 5+
Poisonous; no effect on models immune to poison

regiments.name: Plague Censer Bearers
rules: Must skirmish
Frenzy
Hate all enemies
Enemies suffer -2 to hit them with shooting (including skirmish bonus)

regiments.name: Giant Rat Pack
rules: Giant Rats always pursue

Beastmaster regiment

regiments.name: Rat Ogre Pack
rules: Fear
Beastmaster regiment

warMachines.name: Rat Swarm
rules: Swarm
The smallest Rat Swarm unit counts towards Regiments; subsequent Rat Swarm units count towards war machines/chariots/monsters
Lesser Breed

warMachines.name: Doomwheel
rules: Large chariot
Compulsory move 3D6 inches
On contact counts as charging and inflicts 1D6 S6 impact hits
Lightning: nearest enemy within 12 inches or models in base contact suffer 2D6 hits at artillery-die Strength; misfire wounds Doomwheel

warMachines.name: Lightning Cannon
rules: Lightning line extends 1D6x10 inches
Models crossed suffer a hit at artillery-die Strength, no armour save, each wound becomes 1D6 wounds
First misfire prevents firing next turn; second misfire destroys cannon

warMachines.name: Warpfire Thrower Team
rules: Two Skaven functioning as one model
Skirmisher-like movement and 360-degree line of sight
Enemies suffer -1 to hit with shooting
Cannot move and fire; may stand and shoot
Warpflame is flaming; S5 template; each wound becomes 1D3 wounds; casualties cause panic

warMachines.name: Ratling Gun Team
rules: Two Skaven functioning as one model
Skirmisher-like movement and 360-degree line of sight
Enemies suffer -1 to hit with shooting
Cannot move and fire; may stand and shoot
Range 18 inches; 2D6 S3 armour-piercing shots; doubles fire randomly and hit automatically

warMachines.name: Warplock Jezzail Teams
rules: 1-5 Jezzail teams form a single skirmish unit
The smallest Jezzail unit counts towards Regiments; subsequent Jezzail units count towards war machines
Jezzail: 36 inches, S5, armour piercing, each wound becomes 1D3 wounds

specialCharacters.name: Lord Skrolk, Plaguelord of Clan Pestilens
rules: Frenzy
Terror
May only join Plague Monks
Enemies in base contact suffer -1 to hit in melee

specialCharacters.name: Warlord Queek Head-Taker
rules: Hates Orcs & Goblins and Dwarfs
+1 to hit and +1 to wound in challenges

specialCharacters.name: Throt the Unclean

Cannot be the general

specialCharacterOnlyItems.name: Cloak of Shadows
specialCharacterOnlyItems.rules: If at least 4 inches from the enemy at the start of the turn, cannot be charged, shot or targeted by a spell unless spotted on a 6.

specialCharacterOnlyItems.name: Bands of Power
specialCharacterOnlyItems.rules: Bound spell: doubles the wielder's Strength until the beginning of the next magic phase.

specialCharacterOnlyItems.name: Storm Daemon
specialCharacterOnlyItems.rules: Magic halberd with bound Warp Lightning (24 inches, 1D6 S5 hits, no armour save); after use exhausted on a 1.

specialCharacterOnlyItems.name: Liber Bubonicus
specialCharacterOnlyItems.rules: Makes Lord Skrolk a level 2 wizard with the specified Skaven and Nurgle spell selection.

specialCharacterOnlyItems.name: Rod of Corruption
specialCharacterOnlyItems.rules: Living models hit must pass a Toughness test or die with no save; if passed, roll to wound normally.

specialCharacterOnlyItems.name: Dwarf-Gouger

specialCharacterOnlyItems.name: Warpstone Armour
specialCharacterOnlyItems.rules: Light armour; grants a 4+ ward save. Each saved wound inflicts a S3 hit on the attacker.
